{{Top|leg}}
The '''Otoh Gunga Traffic Control''' was an agency used by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to monitor environmental hazards outside their underwater [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]]. In [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]], [[Goodrow Neb Nob]] reported that the Traffic Control's [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] indicated a seaquake five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] south of [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass's]] position. The report delivered via the [[Comm unit/Legends|comm unit]] informed them that an underwater storm was going to head their way and that they were advised to seek either defensive cover or return to Otoh Gunga immediately.
